theorem L1 (n : Nat) : ps_f1 n = n * n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    simp only [ps_f1, ih, Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_comm]
    omega
sources.L3:
theorem L3 (n : Nat) : 2 * ps_t n = n * (n + 1) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [ps_t, Nat.mul_add, Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_comm] at *; omega
